insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer (Restore Benefit: 100% SI once per year)
great.quote: Restore Benefit Instant addition of 100% Basic Sum Insured on complete or partial utilization of Your existing Policy Sum Insured and Multiplier Benefit (if applicable) during the Policy Year.
great.reference: Section B, In-patient Benefits, 1.a Restore Benefit (page 14)
great.explanation: Provides an extra 100% of your Basic Sum Insured once in the policy year after partial/complete usage—this increases claim-paying capacity beyond the base SI.

great.name: NCB/Renewal Bonus is non-resetting (Multiplier Benefit irrespective of claims)
great.quote: On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 50% of the Base Sum Insured of the expiring Policy shall be provided as multiplier benefit irrespective of any claims
great.explanation: Your bonus sum insured grows on renewal even if you claimed—this is better than standard NCBs that reduce/reset after claims.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: 30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses (accidents covered immediately).

good.name: Specific disease/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Industry-standard 2-year waiting for listed conditions like cataract, hernia, ENT surgeries, etc.

good.name: PED waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: 3-year PED waiting is within standard market range (not a red flag).

good.name: Restore Benefit covers subsequent claims in same policy year (once per year)
good.quote: i. The Sum Insured will be restored only once in a Policy Year. ii. If the Restored Sum Insured is not utilized in a Policy Year, it will expire.
good.reference: Section B, In-patient Benefits, 1.a Restore Benefit conditions (page 14)
good.explanation: Restore is available once per year; still valuable but not unlimited by default (unlimited restore is an optional cover).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: Pre-Hospitalisation expenses... incurred upto 60 days before the date of admission
good.reference: Section B.1.b (page 11) and Schedule of Benefits (page 47-48)
good.explanation: Covers eligible pre-hospitalization expenses up to 60 days (standard/good level).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.quote: Post-Hospitalisation expenses... incurred upto 180 days after discharge from the Hospital
good.reference: Section B.1.c (page 11-12) and Schedule of Benefits (page 47-48)
good.explanation: Covers eligible post-hospitalization expenses up to 180 days (good level).

good.name: Air ambulance covered for higher sum insured slabs (bonus benefit)
good.quote: J(i) The amount payable in case of Air ambulance facility shall be either the actual expenses or Rs. 2.5 Lacs per hospitalisation, whichever is lower
good.reference: Section B.1.j (page 13) and Schedule of Benefits (page 47-48)
good.explanation: Air ambulance is a valuable extra benefit (note: Schedule shows it is Not Covered for 3L & 5L, covered for 10L+).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (Annexure list of non-payable items includes common consumables like gloves, masks, etc.)
bad.quote: Annexure I List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy... 56 GLOVES... 60 MASK... 55 ECG ELECTRODES... 68 VASOFIX SAFETY
bad.explanation: Common consumables can become out-of-pocket during hospitalization, increasing your final bill.

bad.name: No room rent benefit/limit mentioned in this extract (mandatory reporting)
bad.explanation: This extract confirms room rent is covered as part of inpatient treatment but does not state the eligible room category/limit (e.g., Any room/Single AC/with cap). If room rent has a cap, it can cause proportionate deductions—verify the room rent limit in the complete policy wording/schedule.

unclear.name: Co-pay status (default) not explicitly stated; only optional co-pay benefit described
unclear.quote: Co-Payment (Optional benefit) I. If opted and mentioned on the Policy Schedule that a Co-payment is effective
unclear.reference: Section B.2.d Co-Payment (Optional benefit) (page 15-16) and Schedule of Benefits (page 47-48)
unclear.explanation: Co-pay applies only if you opt for it, but the document extract doesn’t clearly confirm the default is 0% co-pay for all ages. Check your policy schedule to confirm whether co-pay is opted (10%/20%).

unclear.name: Cashless network size not mentioned
unclear.quote: Network Provider means Hospital enlisted by an insurer or a TPA... to provide medical services to an insured by a cashless facility
unclear.explanation: Cashless facility is described, but the number of network hospitals is not provided here—verify on insurer website or your policy kit.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
